content.value_statement: Game teams need reliable test coverage from requirements, prototypes, and spreadsheets. This skill turns those inputs into structured Markdown, Excel-ready, or Xmind-ready test cases.
actual_capabilities: Builds a requirement mapping table from game requirement materials.
Generates full test cases with IDs, priorities, preconditions, steps, expected results, and exception branches.
Generates quick checklist-style test points for fast review.
Covers normal, boundary, exception, performance, security, compatibility, and UI scenarios.
Marks unclear or conflicting requirements with suggested options.
Provides local scripts to convert Markdown output into Excel or Xmind-compatible Markdown.
limitations: It does not validate cases against a running game build or live service.
Prototype image interpretation depends on the vision support of the host AI model.
Excel and Xmind conversion require local Python dependencies and well-formed Markdown input.
Generated cases still need QA and product review for business rules and reward values.

use_cases.title: Create QA Coverage From Requirements
use_cases.description: Convert a game feature document into executable test cases with priorities and expected results.

use_cases.title: Review Feature Gaps Before Development
use_cases.description: Identify unclear rules, missing values, and conflicting prototype details before implementation starts.

use_cases.title: Prepare Fast Regression Checklists
use_cases.description: Generate concise test points for login, events, rewards, UI, and compatibility reviews.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Quick Checklist
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a small feature.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use quick mode to create test points for this game feature: [paste feature description]. Include core, boundary, exception, performance, security, compatibility, and UI sections. Mark unclear requirements.

prompt_templates.title: Generate Full Test Cases
prompt_templates.prompt: Use full mode for the attached requirements. Produce case IDs, module names, test type, priority, preconditions, operation steps, expected results, exception branches, and pending questions.

prompt_templates.title: Convert Spreadsheet Requirements
prompt_templates.scenario: Requirements are stored in CSV or Excel.
prompt_templates.prompt: Read the uploaded CSV or XLSX requirements. Build a requirement mapping table, then generate full game test cases with coverage statistics and questions for missing details.

prompt_templates.title: Audit Complex Event Coverage
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced planning for game events or reward systems.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review these event requirements and prototype notes. Identify missing or conflicting rules, generate parameterized test cases, and prepare Markdown that can be converted to Excel and Xmind.

output_examples.input: A login feature with account length rules, lockout rules, and a two-second response target.
output: Requirement map for account login and third-party login coverage.
Quick checklist with core, boundary, exception, performance, security, compatibility, and UI test points.
Pending questions about recovery options and supported third-party providers.

output_examples.input: A lucky wheel event spreadsheet with prize pool, ticket sources, cooldowns, and reward choices.
output: Full test case set for draw flow, ticket acquisition, prize pool refresh, reward delivery, and UI display.
Boundary cases for zero tickets, activity start and end times, jackpot cooldowns, and display limits.
Coverage statistics and unresolved configuration values for product review.

output_examples.input: A prototype image and notes for a new shop screen.
output: UI test points for button placement, text display, price visibility, and state changes.
Exception cases for insufficient currency, network delay, duplicate purchase, and inventory limits.

best_practices: Provide module names, acceptance criteria, data ranges, and known edge cases with each request.
Use quick mode for early review and full mode when cases will be executed by testers.
Resolve pending questions with product owners before importing cases into a test management system.
anti_patterns: Do not treat generated cases as final without QA review.
Do not ask the skill to invent business-critical probabilities or reward values without source requirements.
Do not run conversion scripts on untrusted Markdown without checking the input and output paths.

faq.question: Which tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report declares support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: What input formats does it support?
faq.answer: It is designed for Excel, CSV, plain text, and prototype images when the host model supports image analysis.

faq.question: What output formats can it create?
faq.answer: It primarily creates Markdown. Local helper scripts can convert suitable Markdown to Excel or Xmind-compatible Markdown.

faq.question: Can it generate both detailed and quick cases?
faq.answer: Yes. Full mode creates executable cases, and quick mode creates review-friendly test point lists.

faq.question: Does it replace a QA engineer?
faq.answer: No. It accelerates drafting and coverage analysis, but QA staff must verify rules, data, and feasibility.

faq.question: Does it call external services by itself?
faq.answer: No evidence found. The reviewed files contain documentation and local conversion scripts only.
